package parity

import (
	"context"
	pb "example.com/proto"
	"go.temporal.io/sdk/workflow"
)

const REQUEST_LIMIT = 3

type Customer struct {
	ID uint `gorm:"primaryKey"`
}

func (Customer) TableName() string { return "custom_buyers" }

type Key struct{}
type Item struct{}
type Box[T any] struct{ Value T }

type CreateReq struct {
	g.Meta `path:"/users" method:"POST"`
	Name string
}

type CreateRes struct{}
type UserCtrl struct{}

func (c *UserCtrl) Create(ctx context.Context, req *CreateReq) (*CreateRes, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func handler(v int) int { return v + REQUEST_LIMIT }
func activity() {}

func entry(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) {
	var values map[Key]Box[Item]
	ch := make(chan Item)
	callback := func(v int) int { return handler(v) }
	register(handler)
	workflow.ExecuteActivity(ctx, activity, REQUEST_LIMIT)
	pb.RegisterUserServiceServer(grpc.NewServer(), &UserCtrl{})
	pb.NewUserServiceClient(conn).GetUser(ctx, nil)
	_ = values
	_ = ch
	_ = callback
}

func Register(s *ghttp.Server) {
	s.Group("/", func(g *ghttp.RouterGroup) { g.Bind(new(UserCtrl)) })
}
